newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER ON IMPORT PRESSURE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER ON IMPORT PRESSURE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Tuesday's interbank session softer on hard currencies, pressured down by importer demand that met with little support from inflows.
"There were some buyers in the market but we didn't see many inflows," one dealer commented.
"We haven't seen much tobacco money yet. It looks like the tobacco people are speculating, and waiting for the local dollar to depreciate further before bringing in the funds," he added.
Zimbabwe's annual tobacco auctions opened last week and the local dollar is widely expect to appreciate on the back of funds from the sales.
The Zimbabwe dollar finished the day weaker at 11.3175/3275 against the U.S. dollar compared to 11.3050/3150 and was at 18.4300/4500 from 18.3400/3600 versus pound sterling.
It eased to 2.5400/5600 from 2.5300/5500 against the rand and to 6.5400/5600 on the German mark from 6.5300/5500.
